column3: Content Security Policy Header Not Set
Anti-CSRF tokens: the SPA posts JSON; CSRF is blocked by SameSite=Lax cookies and the Origin check (apps/api/test/security)
CSP: accepted - img/connect allow any https host for the deploy-specific S3 URL; style-src unsafe-inline for Vue/KaTeX/Mermaid
COEP: accepted - require-corp would block presigned images from object storage
Storable/cacheable: intended - hashed assets are immutable, the app shell is no-cache
